offering_description.value: Provides annuities and life insurance for individuals seeking retirement income, savings protection and death benefits. Also provides pension risk transfer and funding solutions to institutional customers.

primary_products.value: Fixed indexed annuities; fixed rate annuities; indexed universal life insurance; group annuities; funding agreements

primary_services.value: Insurance underwriting; pension risk transfer; policy and annuity administration

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individuals saving for retirement, seeking retirement income or purchasing life insurance; B2B: Corporate pension plan sponsors and institutional funding counterparties

end_markets.value: Retirement savings and income; individual life insurance; corporate pension risk management; institutional funding

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Insurance premiums and investment spreads on assets backing annuities, life policies and institutional contracts; service fees: Policy charges and fees for insurance coverage and optional annuity benefits

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Receives premiums and institutional deposits, invests backing assets and pays policy benefits and retirement income; service provider: Underwrites life and longevity risks for individuals and pension plan sponsors

geography_served.value: US national: Serves individual and institutional customers across the United States

company_size.value: Large national insurer with broad independent distribution and an established institutional retirement business

specialization.value: related lines: Annuities, life insurance, pension risk transfer and institutional funding share insurance and investment capabilities

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Independent insurance agents and marketing organizations distribute annuities and life insurance; partners / resellers: Banks and broker-dealers distribute retirement products; direct sales: Institutional relationships for pension risk transfer and funding agreements
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Insurance subsidiaries require state licenses and face state insurance department rules covering solvency, reserves, products and sales practices
